title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (June, 2025)
summary: June 2025 cumulative updates released for Business Central across multiple versions (BC26 CU02, BC25 CU08, BC24 CU14). Includes platform and application build numbers for both cloud SaaS and on-premises deployments, plus lifecycle information showing support dates for versions from 2019 through 2025 release waves.
key_points: BC26 CU02 released with platform 26.0.34852.0 and application 26.2.34746.34995 for cloud; separate builds for on-premises
BC25 introduces flexible environment management with 5-month windows for major updates instead of 30-60 days, and optional minor updates
Multiple versions supported simultaneously: BC26, BC25, BC24 actively receiving updates; BC23 and earlier marked end-of-life or end-of-support
On-premises follows Modern Lifecycle Policy with version 26.x supported until October 2026; Fixed Lifecycle Policy applies to older versions through October 2025

quotes.text: Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows BC25's shift toward greater flexibility in scheduling major updates, reducing urgency from 30-60 days to 5 months

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the support model for modern versions, important for planning upgrade timelines
